name: Excel & Spreadsheets
description: Advanced Excel techniques for data manipulation, summarization, and reporting.

subskills.name: Basic Formulas
subskills.description: Using SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, IF, AND, OR for basic cell calculations.

subskills.name: Pivot Tables
subskills.description: Summarizing large datasets, creating calculated fields, and using slicers.

subskills.name: Data Formatting
subskills.description: Formatting text, numbers, dates, and using text-to-columns.

subskills.name: VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH
subskills.description: Looking up and merging data across sheets using VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, or INDEX/MATCH.

subskills.name: Data Validation
subskills.description: Creating dropdown lists and restricting cell inputs to ensure data integrity.

subskills.name: Conditional Formatting
subskills.description: Applying color scales, data bars, and formula-based formatting rules.

subskills.name: Macros & VBA
subskills.description: Automating repetitive Excel tasks using recorded Macros and VBA scripting.

subskills.name: Power Query
subskills.description: Connecting to external data sources, merging, appending, and transforming data via Power Query.

cv.signal: Mentioned Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, or Power Query

assessment.signal: Can construct a dynamic INDEX/MATCH formula across multiple sheets

junior.description: Can perform basic daily reporting and summarization.

mid.description: Can handle complex lookups and create interactive, validated templates.

senior.description: Can automate data pipelines and build robust VBA applications within Excel.
